description: Tamil Nadu police use AI for crowd management at Tiruvannamalai festival, enhancing safety with real-time density alerts.
body_lead: The Tamil Nadu police have deployed Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to manage crowd and vehicular movement at Tiruvannamalai where several lakhs of people are expected to participate in the Karthigai Deepam festival on Wednesday (December 3, 2025). Police said this is the first time the facility is being used for crowd management in the State. The State police have roped in IT experts who implemented AI-driven applications for crowd management at the Kumbh Mela in Prayagraj early this year.
